title: Uniform Castelnuovo–Mumford regularity bounds for kernels of fixed-rank trivial-sheaf quotients with fixed Hilbert polynomial
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Hyperplane induction controls higher cohomology but leaves the first cohomology obstruction unbounded. The proof shows that any nondecreasing step forces all subsequent steps to be injective and hence zero by eventual vanishing, so strict dimension drops and the Hilbert polynomial give a uniform bound.
